channel.title: The Grant Desk - AI, Tech & Research, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: AI, Tech & Research, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: NBER i3: Open Data Fellows Program 2027
item.description: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), Innovation Information Initiative (i3) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 1,500 per fellow, at least five fellowships, plus travel reimbursement to present at the i3 Technical Working Group meeting in December 2027. No application fee.

item.title: Generator Residency (Kairos x Constellation, Winter 2027)
item.description: Kairos and Constellation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 8,500 per month stipend (some Embedded track residents employed at a roughly equivalent salary), plus travel to and from Berkeley. No application fee.

item.title: City of Palo Alto Code:ART 2027: Lytton Plaza Installation Commission (USD 20,000)
item.description: City of Palo Alto Public Art Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · USD 20,000 commission budget. No application fee.

item.title: City of Palo Alto Code:ART 2027: Interactive Media Installations (up to USD 9,000 each)
item.description: City of Palo Alto Public Art Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 9,000 per installation, for up to five installations. No application fee.

item.title: Postdoctoral Fellow 2027, Crockett Lab (Princeton Psychology and University Center for Human Values)
item.description: Princeton University, Crockett Lab (Department of Psychology and University Center for Human Values) · deadline 20 Nov 2026 · USD 80,000 annual salary from a stable institutional funding source (not a cancellable grant).

item.title: CISAC (Stanford): Fellowships 2027-2028 (AI, Nuclear & International Security)
item.description: Center for International Security and Cooperation (CISAC), Stanford FSI · deadline 02 Dec 2026 · Funded in-residence fellowship. Predoctoral fellows receive stipends comparable to the Stanford Graduate Fellowships program, plus CISAC pays non-matriculated student tuition; postdoctoral and junior-faculty/professional fellows receive stipends commensurate with experience and Stanford's established minimums. Specific dollar figures are not published. No application fee.

item.title: Coding it Forward: Winter Fellowship 2027 (US civic tech placements)
item.description: Coding it Forward · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Paid full-time job placement: USD 20 per hour for applicants with a Bachelor's degree, USD 25 per hour for applicants pursuing or holding a graduate degree (Master's or PhD), at 40 hours per week for ten weeks (roughly USD 8,000 to 10,000 in total). Pay rates and work dates are non-negotiable. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic STEM Fellows Program 2027 (four-month AI-for-science fellowship, January to May 2027)
item.description: Anthropic · deadline 28 Oct 2026 · USD 100,000 to 167,000 for the four-month fellowship (equivalent to USD 300,000 to 500,000 annualised), plus benefits; fellows are engaged through an employer of record on a fixed-term contract. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute: AI for Science and Safety Nodes RFP 2026 (Local Compute; Coordination and Accountability; AI-first Science)
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Grants typically USD 30,000 to 100,000 (smaller awards for the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance and Open Governance areas, larger for the rest; bigger amounts possible for the right project), usually paid as one lump sum, with up to 10 percent overhead. Optional office space in San Francisco or Berlin and access to private compute clusters. No application fee.

item.title: Processing Foundation Fellowship 2027
item.description: Processing Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 10,000 stipend over the 8-month fellowship, plus open-source software mentorship, cohort collaboration, professional development and public presentation opportunities. No application fee.

item.title: Loeb Fellowship 2027-28 at Harvard Graduate School of Design
item.description: Harvard Graduate School of Design · deadline 05 Jan 2027 · Stipend of USD 57,500 for the academic year (taxable), plus housing for fellows and their families coming from outside the Boston/Cambridge area through 30 June, and a travel grant covering approximately one economy round trip home per semester. No application fee.

item.title: Andrew Carnegie Fellows Program 2027
item.description: Carnegie Corporation of New York · deadline 13 Nov 2026 · USD 200,000 over one to two years for research and writing toward a book or major study. NOTE: institutional nomination required; individuals cannot apply directly.

item.title: Eyebeam AGENCY NYC Residency, Spring 2027
item.description: Eyebeam · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · USD 5,000 stipend per selected artist, plus mentorship and access to tools and technical expertise through Eyebeam's network. No application fee (via Submittable).

item.title: CURRENTS 2027 Art & Technology Festival: Call for Submissions (Santa Fe)
item.description: CURRENTS New Media / Parallel Studios · deadline 08 Dec 2026 · NO GUARANTEED CASH, listed as a deliberate exception to the desk's paid-only rule: selected artists may be eligible for travel, lodging and shipping support, decided case by case, and the festival may be able to supply needed equipment. International shipping support is explicitly uncertain due to cost. SUBMISSION FEE: USD 30 for a single work, USD 25 each for multiple works.

item.title: Burning Man: BRC Honoraria Art Grants 2027 (Letter of Intent)
item.description: Burning Man Project · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · USD 1.5 million annual art-grant budget across approximately 75 projects; grants fund 40 to 60% of the proposed total budget, and the official page notes grants over USD 20,000 are rare. No fixed per-award figure is published. No application fee.

item.title: American Academy in Rome: Rome Prize Fellowship 2027-28
item.description: American Academy in Rome · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Stipends of USD 16,000 (half-term, about 5 months) and USD 30,000 (full-term, about 10 months), plus housing, workspace and weekday meals. Approximately 30 fellowships per year. APPLICATION FEE: USD 50 by 1 November (USD 60 for multiple categories); USD 80/90 in the late window to 15 November.

item.title: Beam Center: 2027 Beam Camp Project Open Call (USD 5,000 commission, remote-friendly)
item.description: Beam Center · deadline 30 Nov 2026 · USD 5,000 award to the selected proposer, plus a fabrication budget of approximately USD 15,000. No application fee.

item.title: Wave Farm: 2027 Research and Production Program (Transmission Art Residencies and Radio Art Fellowships, NY)
item.description: Wave Farm · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · USD 1,000 stipend for each 10-day residency; USD 2,000 for each two-month Radio Art Fellowship. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund (research grants on AI's economic impacts)
item.description: Anthropic · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 200 million committed overall. Grants primarily in the USD 5-30 million range per project, with a USD 1 million minimum and flexibility upward for well-scoped, high-potential-impact projects. The separate small-grant Research Awards tier (USD 10,000-50,000 plus USD 5,000 in Claude API credits) is currently paused. No application fee.

item.title: Eyebeam AGENCY Virtual Residency, Fall 2026 (US-based artists)
item.description: Eyebeam · deadline 11 Oct 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend for each of six selected artists, plus weekly residency programming, mentorship with Eyebeam alumni and visiting professionals, technical consultation, and access to tools and expertise through Eyebeam's network. No application fee (via Submittable).

item.title: Transluce: Governance & Policy Fellow (San Francisco)
item.description: Transluce · deadline 20 Oct 2026 · USD 200,000 to 300,000 per year salary plus benefits. Full-time; part-time possible for exceptional candidates.

item.title: Sanford Underground Research Facility: Artist-in-Residence Program 2027 (Lead, South Dakota)
item.description: Sanford Underground Research Facility (SURF) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 5,000 stipend paid in two installments, plus up to USD 5,000 in additional funds the artist may apply for to create the artwork. Transportation (airfare, rental car or mileage), housing and per diem are covered for both visits; a studio space and guided surface and underground tours are provided; return shipping of the exhibition is covered up to USD 7,000.

item.title: Harry Ransom Center Research Fellowships 2027-2028 (Austin, Texas)
item.description: Harry Ransom Center, The University of Texas at Austin · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · Postdoctoral Fellowships: USD 3,500 per month for one or two months. Dissertation Fellowships: USD 2,500. Travel Stipends: USD 2,000 (open to graduate students, faculty and independent researchers including artists and journalists). International recipients get an extra USD 500. No application fee.

item.title: Data Through Design 2027 Open Call: 10th Anniversary Exhibition (New York City)
item.description: Data Through Design (DxD) · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · USD 900 stipend per selected project, paid half in the weeks leading up to the exhibition and half after. No application fee.

item.title: MoHA: CATS+ Residency 2026 (Austin)
item.description: The Museum of Human Achievement (MoHA) · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · USD 1,500 honorarium, plus access to MoHA equipment and workspaces.

item.title: IAPS: AI Policy Fellowship Spring 2027 (DC, London or remote)
item.description: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · Fellows receive USD 18,000 and Senior Fellows USD 24,000 as a stipend for the three-month full-time program, plus an additional USD 3,000 stipend on the in-person DC or London tracks, healthcare benefits and a USD 500 professional development stipend. Up to 45 fellows. No application fee.

item.title: Humanity AI: Open Call for Proposals 2026
item.description: Humanity AI (coalition of 10 philanthropies) · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · USD 10 million total pool, grants of USD 75,000 to 1,000,000 across three tiers: Tier 1 USD 75,000-150,000; Tier 2 USD 150,000-500,000; Tier 3 USD 500,000-1,000,000. Grants run up to three years. No application fee.

item.title: ILIAD Fellowship: Mentored AI Alignment Research (November and December 2026 cohorts)
item.description: ILIAD · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 6,000 per month travel-and-housing allowance for the 3-month fellowship. No tuition or application fee.

item.title: MATS Residency Program: 6-24 Month Funded AI Safety Research (Winter 2027 intake)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 155,000 to 285,000 per year gross (set by location, seniority, and experience), plus medical/dental/vision/life insurance, retirement plan, paid time off, conference funding, catered meals, and up to USD 25,000 relocation support. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute AI Nodes RFP, Track I: Local Compute
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant (larger possible for the right project), plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute AI Nodes RFP, Track II: Coordination and Accountability
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant, with smaller amounts for the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance & Open Governance focus areas; plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute AI Nodes RFP, Track III: AI-First Science (Bio, Neuro, Nano)
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant, with higher amounts for this track than the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance areas (larger possible for the right project); plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: American-Scandinavian Foundation: Fellowships for Americans in the Nordic Countries 2027-28
item.description: American-Scandinavian Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Long-term fellowships of up to USD 23,000 for 4 to 12 months; short-term grants of up to USD 5,000 for 1 to 3 months. In 2026, 31 American Fellows received over USD 277,390 in total funding. Awards are given in all fields, including creative arts projects.

item.title: Institute for Law & AI: Summer Fellowship US 2027 (Washington DC)
item.description: Institute for Law & AI (LawAI) · deadline 29 Jan 2027 · USD 2,000 per week subsidy, plus a USD 10,000 relocation/housing stipend for DC-based fellows and covered travel, accommodation and meals for the Convening Week; higher subsidies possible for exceptional candidates. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic Fellows Program (funded AI research fellowship, January 2027 cohort)
item.description: Anthropic (with Constellation as recruiting partner) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,850 / GBP 2,310 / CAD 4,300 per week for four months of full-time research, plus roughly USD 15,000 per month in compute funding and other research expenses. No application fee.

item.title: MATS Winter 2027 Fellowship (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · USD 19,200 stipend plus USD 24,000 compute budget, with free housing and food, travel covered, and J-1 visa sponsorship if needed. No application fee.

item.title: CBAI Fall Research Fellowship in AI Safety 2026 (Cambridge, MA)
item.description: Cambridge Boston Alignment Initiative (CBAI) · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · USD 15,000 stipend over 10 weeks, plus roughly USD 1,500 per week of compute support (API credits), housing via corporate rentals, free weekday meals and snacks, and conference costs for accepted papers. No application fee.

item.title: CBAI AIxBiosecurity Research Fellowship Fall 2026 (Cambridge, MA)
item.description: Cambridge Boston Alignment Initiative (CBAI) · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · USD 15,000 stipend over 10 weeks, plus roughly USD 1,500 per week of compute support (API credits and GPUs), housing via corporate rentals, free weekday meals and snacks, and conference costs for accepted papers. No application fee.

item.title: FAS: AI Safety Policy Entrepreneurship Fellowship 2026-27 (part-time, remote)
item.description: Federation of American Scientists (Day One Project) · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · USD 5,000 stipend for the part-time fellowship (about 5 hours per week), plus a USD 1,000 merit award for the most actionable policy memo and advocacy plan. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute: AI for Science & Safety Nodes RFP
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant, with smaller amounts for the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance & Open Governance focus areas and higher amounts for the rest (larger possible for the right project), plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: 4 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• New_ Public Entrepreneur in Residence, Pilot Cohort
    https://newpublic.org/EIR
    New_ Public · deadline 09 Sep 2026 · Stipend of USD 22,500, paid in three monthly installments across the residency, each contingent on continued active participation. Plus USD 1,500 toward an AI tool of the resident's choice for coding, prototyping or design. Two residents are selected in the pilot cohort. Also provided: hands-on product and strategy support from senior New_ Public staff and outside experts; access to New_ Public's five years of original research on moderation, governance, community stewardship and platform design, plus direct access to the researchers behind it; and introductions across New_ Public's network of major platforms, startups, university researchers and funders for hiring, fundraising, early user testing and community partnerships. Residents must submit a Form W-9 or W-8BEN to receive the stipend. No application fee.
  • Kluge Fellowships at the Library of Congress 2027
    https://www.loc.gov/programs/john-w-kluge-center/chairs-fellowships/fellowships/kluge-fellowships/
    John W. Kluge Center, Library of Congress · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Stipend of USD 5,000 per month for a residency of four to eleven months, so USD 20,000 to USD 55,000 depending on the tenure awarded. Twelve Kluge Fellowships are awarded each year. Stipends are paid monthly by electronic transfer to a U.S. bank account. No application fee, no participation fee.
  • ACLS Digital Justice Grants 2026-27 (Seed and Development)
    https://www.acls.org/programs/acls-digital-justice-grants/
    American Council of Learned Societies (ACLS), funded by the Mellon Foundation · deadline 03 Nov 2026 · Seed Grants USD 10,000 to 25,000 for start-up and prototyping work; Development Grants USD 50,000 to 100,000 for projects past proof of concept. Institutional indirect costs are not covered. No application fee.
  • ILIAD Intensive: Foundational AI Alignment Program (London and Berkeley)
    https://www.iliad.ac/intensive
    ILIAD · deadline Rolling / undated · No tuition. USD 5,000 travel and housing allowance per participant, plus office space at the venue and lunch and dinner five days a week. Cohorts of 15 to 30 participants. Participants arrange and pay for their own travel and accommodation out of the allowance.

item.description:

    https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/humanrightswatch/jobs/8350654002
    Human Rights Watch (HRW), Operations Department · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · USD 102,000 to 112,000 plus employer-paid benefits if based in the US; ranges outside the US are set by local market conditions. No application fee.

    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/

Fellows receive a stipend, access to physical robot platforms, compute for simulation and training, and structured mentorship. PAISI was seeded by a grant from BlueDot Impact. Free to submit an expression of interest.
